verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1994 (US).

notes.text:
Gatefold sleeve including lined black inner sleeve, all inside a clear plastic envelope with black sticker on front: "Music On Vinyl® Classic Album 180 gram audiophile vinyl pressing www.musiconvinyl.com"
Tracks listed consecutively on back cover under side headings.

Inside gatefold:
All songs published by WB Music Corp./Green Lantern Music/Prison Bride Music. ASCAP.

Rear:
Originally released ℗ & © 1994 Atlantic Recording Corporation
Manufactured & distributed by Music On Vinyl B.V. 2018 under exclusive license from Warner Music Benelux B.V., a Warner Music Group Company. Made in the EU.
